name: HWR_XP_EXTENSION_B
description: This is the table for the experience store extensions.

columns.name: EXTENSION_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for this extension.

columns.name: CONTEXT_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for the context.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for this activity.

columns.name: RESULT_ID
columns.description: The Unique database identifier for this result.

columns.name: ID_IRI
columns.description: The id iri for this extension. The ID should follow the IRI sandard.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: The value for this extension. Can be null.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
